fields.Name: T209 - System Diagnostics Perfmon Chart Zoom Controls
fields.Description: Exercises the D3 perfmon chart control surface (zoomPerfChart / setChartInteractionMode / gap compression) — a bespoke visualization interaction path unlike any tabular/grid feature.

InputDefinition.goal: You are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the Admin application, open 'Monitoring', select System Diagnostics, open the 'Performance' section, and ensure the 'Monitor' sub-tab is selected. Confirm the performance-monitor chart area renders with a controls row: interaction-mode buttons (pointer / select / pan), zoom-in, zoom-out, reset-zoom, and a 'Compress Gaps' checkbox. Click the zoom-in button a couple of times and then the reset button, and confirm the controls respond (e.g. the footer 'zoom' percentage updates, or the chart re-renders). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the chart controls render and respond to zoom/reset clicks is success — the chart may be sparse if little telemetry exists.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Monitor sub-tab shows a chart container with a controls row: interaction modes, zoom in/out, reset zoom, and a Compress Gaps toggle
Clicking zoom-in and then reset produces a visible response (footer zoom percentage change and/or chart re-render) without breaking the chart
The interaction-mode buttons (pointer/select/pan) can be selected and show an active state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
